summary: The host discusses a new initiative involving 12 teams receiving seed funding and mentorship, noting its similarity to Spotify's past model and highlighting Jenna Weiss-Berman and Amit Dashi as co-chairs of the advisory committee. The speaker promotes their upcoming appearance at the Sound Education Conference in Boston and encourages listeners to continue using the #PodsInColor hashtag on social media. The segment concludes with an introduction to an interview with Favi (also known as Fovy Fov), who prefers being called Favi or Justin.
